:::{#exm-prob-from-odds-auto}
#### The probability that a car in the Auto data is American, from the odds

<!-- no-figure: the example checks one number computed two ways -->

For the [event](#def-event) $A$ of @exm-odds-auto,
@lem-prob-from-odds says that the [odds](#def-odds) over one plus the odds
is the [probability](#def-probability) that the car is American:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
odds_american <- p_american / (1 - p_american)
c(from_odds = odds_american / (1 + odds_american), probability = p_american)
```

Both ways give `{r} round(p_american, 3)`.
:::
